test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Six girls M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting on a bench facing towards the east. M is sitting between P and Q. Only two girls are sitting to the right of Q. R is sitting to the immediate left of P.

Who is sitting at the extreme left end?
solution: Six girls M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting on a bench facing towards the east. 1) Only two girls are sitting to the right of Q.
